verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a Dashboard REST API that returns chart data in JSON (amplitude-docs-30) and APIs for exporting events and managing cohorts (amplitude-docs-12, amplitude-docs-29), but there is no evidence of an API to create, edit, or manage dashboards or saved insights themselves — only to read data off existing dashboards. missing for 10: evidence of programmatic dashboard/insight creation, updating, or deletion via API, and any SDK/CLI tooling for managing saved insights.
